text:
claire: Quick alert after deploy rbac-consolidate: some org viewers lost access to Settings -> API keys. Repro: user u_700 cannot list API keys (403) though org API says role=viewer.

drew: Which deploy? Any migration in the window?

claire: deploy tag rbac-consolidate-2026-02-14. Migrator run id mig-20260214-09 ran right after. Example: org-61, project p_iac_2.

vikram: Show the two permission endpoints pls.

claire: Org: `{ "user":"u_700", "role":"viewer", "permissions":["view_project","api_keys:view"] }`
Project: `{ "user":"u_700", "role": null, "permissions": [] }`

ops-bot: migrator: mig-20260214-09 started by svc rbac-migrator@infra at 2026-02-14T11:02Z.

vikram: Likely the migrator wrote empty project rows instead of leaving inherit. Quick mitigation: UI should check org perms when project perms empty. I'll push a tiny fallback behind flag `rbac.ui.org-fallback` and add tooltip "Using org-level permission" and add tooltip "Using org-level permission".

sec-oncall: Impact low security but customer-visible. P2. Capture migrator run id + KMS logs. If KMS decrypt used, check for transient errors.

drew: Forensics: migrator logs show a single KMS transient `DECRYPT_NOT_AUTHORIZED` at 11:03:21Z then retries. rbac_migration record shows org-61 state=partial.

claire: Requeued migrator retry mig-20260214-09-retry; infra-bot queued it.

ops-bot: migrator run mig-20260214-09-retry completed at 2026-02-14T11:07Z; org-61 state -> complete. Post-check: project perms now inherit org permissions.

vikram: Plan: add retry/backoff for KMS in migrator, add post-check that no empty aliases exist, and add alert when rbac_migration.state='partial' > 3m. Added follow-ups to INC-20260214-4.

claire: Verified with user u_700; API Keys visible again. Removing UI fallback flag in 30m. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
